item.title: Classical Object Detectors vs. MLLMs for Child Detection in Images
item.description: The main goal of this experiment is to identify all children appearing in the images from the Parenting Slop Dataset. (Links and broader description of data can be found in data/parenting_slop_dataset directory). A key assumption is to minimize or eliminate the need for additional data collection for training and do not use cloud-based infrastructure. Therefore, all models considered in the comparison are open-source and open-weighted.
